name: genesis-task-ledger

integration.reviewer: {id, taskId, acceptanceDigest, configured:true, independent:true, verdict:'accept', checksDigest, artifactsDigest}; id must differ from workerId and task binding must match
integration.check: {taskId,acceptanceDigest,criterionId,checkId,passed:true,command,exitCode:0,checkedCount,expectedCount,artifacts:[artifactProof],revisionId?}; taskId/acceptanceDigest must match the registered task, checkedCount must equal expectedCount and artifacts must exactly match outcome artifacts

limitations: Reviewer identity is caller-attested, not cryptographically authenticated.
State is local and synchronous; use an external lock for multi-process writers.
